heroSub: The project implemented at Nuh'un Ankara's production facility in Ankara provides carton and pallet-level traceability while enabling the monitoring of all product movements between the factory, external warehouses, and customers.
contextTitle: Traceable logistics from production to customer
contextP1: Nuh'un Ankara operates a food manufacturing facility in Ankara. The project was launched to establish carton and pallet-level traceability throughout production and shipping operations.
contextP2: The system enables the recording and monitoring of all product movements between the factory, external warehouses, and customers from a single platform.
problemLede: It was necessary to identify which cartons were loaded onto which pallets and track their movements throughout the supply chain. Manual tracking created traceability gaps and increased recall and shipment risks.

problemList.text: Manual tracking of carton and pallet relationships created risks in data accuracy and product visibility.
Lack of centralized monitoring for external warehouse and customer transfers reduced operational visibility.

solutionLede: A traceability solution was implemented on the production and shipping lines. Cartons and pallets are automatically associated, while warehouse and customer transfers are recorded through handheld terminals.

steps.title: Carton Identification
steps.text: Cartons are uniquely identified and registered in the system.

steps.title: Pallet Association
steps.text: Cartons are assigned to the corresponding pallets and recorded.

steps.title: Transfer Registration
steps.text: Warehouse and customer transfers are recorded using handheld devices.

steps.title: Monitoring and Reporting
steps.text: All movements are tracked and reported through the OnSuite Trace platform.

techTitle: PLC automation, SCADA, and mobile applications

techGrid.title: PLC Infrastructure
techGrid.text: Industrial PLC architecture managing field automation and process control.

techGrid.title: C# SCADA Application
techGrid.text: Central software platform managing traceability and shipment operations.

techGrid.title: Barcode Readers
techGrid.text: Devices used to identify and verify carton and pallet information.

techGrid.title: Handheld Terminal Application
techGrid.text: Mobile solution for registering warehouse and customer transfers in the field.

integrationDesc: Traceability and shipment data are exchanged with Netsis ERP, enabling centralized process management.

integrationList.text: Transfer and traceability data are synchronized with the company's Netsis ERP environment.

resultsTitle: Complete visibility and stronger recall management

resultsGrid.title: End-to-End Traceability
resultsGrid.text: All product movements from production to customer are fully traceable.

resultsGrid.title: Digital Transfer Management
resultsGrid.text: Warehouse and customer transfers are centrally recorded and managed.

resultsGrid.title: Improved Shipment Accuracy
resultsGrid.text: Recall processes are accelerated and shipment reliability is strengthened.
